title: Several code parts aren't gated properly to check null pointers and can lead to crash
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.6 master branch 20b67f3661c5434bd9a39268160aff33c90e0d81


### System information

Windows 10 ( but most likely any OS is concerned )

### Issue description


I have been running a CppCheck task in exhaustive mode with warning level 4 for Windows target and I have noticed a certain amount of code parts that are not gated properly with checks for nullptr and thus can lead to crash.

For example:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/20b67f3661c5434bd9a39268160aff33c90e0d81/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp#L1243-L1244
Here "p_render_data" is not gated and could lead to crash.

or
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/20b67f3661c5434bd9a39268160aff33c90e0d81/scene/3d/ik_modifier_3d.cpp#L162-L163
Here "p_skeleton" is not gated and could lead to crash.

I will try to continue looking at my analysis results and make a PR addressing all those that I find to add a ERR_FAIL_NULL guard for each to make the code more robust.

### Steps to reproduce

Use any of the methods listed can potentially lead to crash

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I don't have MRP
